selected_option.label: Cross-candidate relations (Recommended)
selected_option.description: relations may connect independently evidenced candidate endpoints. Each edge binds its own owner plus exact source/target evidence. This supports real depends_on, interface, event, and consumption relationships.

presented_options.label: Cross-candidate relations (Recommended)
presented_options.description: relations may connect independently evidenced candidate endpoints. Each edge binds its own owner plus exact source/target evidence. This supports real depends_on, interface, event, and consumption relationships.

presented_options.label: Candidate-local only
presented_options.description: source, target, and relation must share one candidate owner. Simpler, but cross-candidate architecture edges require a future separate graph layer.

presented_options.label: Defer
presented_options.description: leave the package unreceipted and unapplied.

rationale: The selected relation-owner model supports cross-candidate architecture edges without collapsing endpoint evidence or relation ownership. Each relation will bind an independently evidenced relation-owner candidate plus exact source and target endpoint candidate/evidence identities.

scope.proposal_status: accepted proposal receipt e553ce0cd91a8a8d2b5c92323ff41c64752d64875419b6afd51dbd4e3d29bb82 is a historical base; schema amendments require fresh exact owner acceptance
scope.selected_relation_semantics: relation candidate_id identifies the relation-owner candidate; source and target endpoints bind their own candidate ids and exact evidence bundles; no source-target-owner candidate equality is required
